name: LunaJoy Health
one_liner: Online therapy, medication management and coaching for women, including pregnancy, postpartum, fertility and menopause mental health.
best_for: Women with anxiety or depression during pregnancy or after birth
Women dealing with infertility, pregnancy loss or menopause who want a specialist
Women who want therapy and non-controlled medication management in one place
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988; for postpartum psychosis or thoughts of harming yourself or your baby, call 911
People who need controlled substances such as stimulants or benzodiazepines
Men, and people outside the states it serves
People who need in-person or intensive care
short_description: Virtual therapy and medication management for women, focused on perinatal, fertility and menopause care; some insurance or $125–$240 self-pay.
long_description: LunaJoy Health is a virtual mental health practice for women. It offers talk therapy, medication management with psychiatric prescribers (who do not prescribe controlled substances) and wellness coaching, with a focus on reproductive and maternal mental health: infertility, pregnancy, postpartum and menopause, as well as anxiety and depression. Visits are by video on a HIPAA-secure platform. It is in-network with some plans, including Aetna and Cigna, and lists self-pay prices of $150 for a first therapy visit and $125 for follow-ups, and $240 for a first medication visit and $150 for follow-ups; in New York visits are private pay. It is available in about a dozen states and DC. No published study of LunaJoy's care was found.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; self-pay therapy $150 first visit, then $125/session
pricing.notes: Self-pay medication management: $240 first visit, then $150/visit (genetic testing may cost extra). In-network with some plans including Aetna and Cigna; in New York visits are private pay.

privacy.notes: Says it will never sell personally identifying information, but uses Google Ads tracking cookies on its site to show you ads; treatment records are covered by its HIPAA notice.

patient_summary: You book a video visit with a LunaJoy therapist or psychiatric prescriber who focuses on women's mental health, including pregnancy, postpartum, infertility and menopause. It takes some insurance plans such as Aetna and Cigna; self-pay therapy is $150 for the first visit and $125 after, and medication management is $240 then $150.
